basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old from Portland, Oregon, working as a junior software developer. I recently got into Reddit to explore niche communities and connect with people who share similar interests. I'm particularly fascinated by fantasy storytelling and gaming, with a keen interest in interactive storytelling games. Being a night owl, I'm usually online during late evenings. I'm single and enjoy the laid-back lifestyle of the Pacific Northwest.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having graduated from Oregon State University. I am self-taught in game development and have spent countless hours experimenting with game design in platforms like Terraria. My interest in storytelling has led me to explore various writing communities, where I occasionally contribute ideas.
